enum ledger.CrossingForecastFailure.note: OutsideForecastRange with its three fields as the reference's; beside it the cases where the reference's forecast of a Dijkstra view cannot fail but the node's can (the translation into Dijkstra refused, a parameter that does not fit its word, a word of the vocabulary), each a defect of the node's own state that the header rules report as no verdict (HeaderDefect.DijkstraView). Moved from consensus so that a header defect can carry it (#54)

enum ledger.Praos2Error.note: one closed type for what Praos2.validate refuses, where the reference has the envelope errors of validateEnvelope (UnexpectedBlockNo, UnexpectedSlotNo, UnexpectedPrevHash, the checkpoint and Shelley's envelope errors under Envelope) beside PolyPraosValidationErr; the VRF and leader failures Praos2 shares with Praos keep their PraosError and the certificate signatures their OCertError. Moved from consensus so that HeaderError can carry it (#54). Praos2ReferenceSuite maps each case to the constructor the reference's validateHeader returns on the same input

glue.reason: the node's own reasons for reaching no verdict on a header where the reference throws an exception the ChainSync client does not catch (PastHorizonException, a successor or narrowing of a machine word, a configuration it never builds), which end the peer's session uncharged (PeerError.HeaderUndecided), and their rendering (#54)
the rendering of a Praos2 header refusal in the node's validation messages; the reference renders PolyPraosValidationErr with its derived Show (#54)
